Lyrics:
Baby, baby if you leave me 
Can you take me with you 
I can sit in the back seat 
Sometimes when the night is quiet 
I’ll turn all the lights on, like the end of the movie
 
I can’t wait, but I’m waiting 
I’m still up, but I’m fading 

Not so slowly getting older 
California sober 
I live by the water 
Go dancing with my understudy 
Could be anybody 
Make me an offer 
I’m not good, but I’m better 
Missed my cue but whatever 
It’s now or never 

All my life 
Side by side 
Hyde Jekyll Hyde 
Finally together 
You can change your mind 
But you can’t change mine 
Hyde Jekyll Hyde 
You and I forever 

Walking early in the morning 
While you’re still sleeping 
And the credits are rolling 
I don’t know why I’m crying 
Until we’re dead or die trying

-

Miles Morales Spider-Man Easter Eggs.

Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink Jean Grey, Jean Grey Phoenix Powers. Spider-Man Brand New Day Post Credit Scene & Avengers Doomsday Trailer Connection. Robert Downey Jr Doctor Doom, New Black Panther, X-Men, Doctor Strange, Avengers Secret Wars First Look, Battleworld MCU. Fantastic Four, Franklin Richards. Ian McKellen Magneto, Patrick Stewart Professor X, Kelsey Grammer Beast, Thor Returns, Mystique, Cyclops, Nightcrawler, Original X-Men.

Why Marvel is rebooting the MCU with Avengers 6 Secret Wars. What's going to change with all the Avengers, New Iron Man, X-Men Mutants like Wolverine, Deadpool, Fantastic Four, Ghost Rider, Spider-Man and other characters. Lots more Marvel Trailers coming Avengers Doomsday Trailer and more Spider-Man Brand New Day videos and footage! 

My X-Men 2028 Teaser video will post next. My Visionquest Trailer video will post after that. Then my Ahsoka Season 2 Trailer video and My Lanterns Episode 1 video!

snippet.title: Avengers Doomsday TRAILER 2 REACTION!! Doctor Doom Special Look | Sentinels
snippet.description:
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY JUST GOT EVEN BIGGER — AND DOCTOR DOOM LOOKS ABSOLUTELY TERRIFYING!

#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #RobertDowneyJr #D23 #TrailerReaction #MarvelStudios #MCU #FantasticFour #XMen #ReelRejects 

Aaron Alexander & John Humphrey react to the brand-new Avengers: Doomsday trailer revealed at D23, featuring Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom and a massive collision between the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men, Wakandans, and more. Directed by Anthony & Joe Russo, Avengers: Doomsday stars Robert Downey Jr. (Iron Man, Oppenheimer) as Doctor Doom, Pedro Pascal (The Last of Us, The Mandalorian) as Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic, Vanessa Kirby (The Fantastic Four: First Steps, Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning) as Sue Storm, Chris Hemsworth (Thor, Extraction) as Thor, Patrick Stewart (X-Men, Star Trek: Picard) as Professor X, and Ian McKellen (The Lord of the Rings, X-Men) as Magneto.

After watching the new D23 footage, Aaron and John break down Doctor Doom’s ominous introduction, his green eyes, ceremonial armor, devastated surroundings, and the trailer’s heavy focus on his history with the Fantastic Four. They react to Reed Richards confronting Doom, the emotional hints surrounding Doom’s tragic past, Thor being blasted away with seemingly little effort, and the sheer power and presence Robert Downey Jr. brings to Marvel’s next major villain.

The conversation also explores the massive scope of Avengers: Doomsday, including appearances from Professor X, Magneto, Gambit, Wakandan heroes, Sentinels, and the larger multiversal conflict bringing multiple Marvel worlds together. Aaron and John discuss how the darker visual language surrounding Doom contrasts with the retro-futuristic world of the Fantastic Four, why the Reed and Doom relationship may provide the emotional core of the movie, and whether Doomsday could ultimately reset the MCU timeline heading into Avengers: Secret Wars.

Letra

Qué tristeza me da saber que si no traes pasta, no te respetan
La puta sociedad se basa en lo que brilla y en lo que aparenta
Puedes ser el más falso, pero si ante las personas traes careta
Todos te creen el cuento, y si eres cagada, nadie se da cuenta
Las buenas amistades se extinguieron junto con los dinosaurios
Y si hablo de lealtad, me refiero a mí 'amá, que nunca me ha fallado
Tengo un amigo leal, que se ganó el lugar, y ahora le llamo hermano
Tal vez no es de mi sangre, pero como si lo fuera se ha portado
Hay que ser selectivo, que no todo mundo trae la misma vibra
Hay gente muy corriente, que nomás se arrima para ver que chinga
Primero piden mano y cuando se la brindas
Quieren mocharte el pie, nada más para ver después como caminas
Las vibras nunca mienten, y el sexto sentido nunca se equivoca
Hay que alejarse más de la gente que tira mierda por la boca
Al que habla por hablar, lo van a castigar, pero esa es otra cosa
Que elija cada quien el problema con el que quiera hacerse bola
Para ver quién es quién se hicieron las caídas y los malos tiempos
Porque bajo presión se hicieron los diamantes de más alto precio
Dinero hay para todos, pero es que no a todos les cae bien un peso
El poder y la fama, cuando no estás preparado, te hacen menso
Y es que a mi corta edad, les puedo asegurar, que ya he visto de todo
Ricos que se hacen pobres, y pobres bien ricos queriéndolo todo
Nadie valora nada, y quieren más billete
Yo le agradezco a Dios que con vida y salud disfruto mi presente

Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, and the writing team of Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. In the film, the Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and the X-Men converge from different universes to face Doom.

Two new Avengers films, The Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars, were announced in July 2022 as the conclusion of the MCU's Phase Six and "The Multiverse Saga". Jonathan Majors was set to reprise his MCU role as the villain Kang the Conqueror, with Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeff Loveness hired to direct and write The Kang Dynasty, respectively. In November 2023, Cretton departed, Waldron replaced Loveness as writer, and Marvel was considering moving away from the Kang storyline, in part due to Majors's legal issues; Majors was fired the following month. The return of the Russo brothers as directors and McFeely as co-writer, the casting of Downey as new villain Doctor Doom, and the new subtitle Doomsday were all announced in July 2024. The large cast features actors from previous MCU media and 20th Century Fox's X-Men film series, using the idea of colliding universes to bring together actors from different franchises. Filming took place from April to September 2025 at Pinewood Studios in England, with location filming in England and Bahrain.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to be released in the United States on December 18, 2026, as part of Phase Six of the MCU. The sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars, is set to be released on December 17, 2027.

snippet.title: Avengers: Doomsday | Special Look REACTION!
snippet.description: Avengers: Doomsday | Special Look REACTION!The wait is officially over, geeks — Luke and Audrey are reacting to the brand new Avengers: Doomsday Special Look, and it lived up to every ounce of hype! From the second that Doctor Doom silhouette hit the screen, we knew this was going to be a reaction for the ages. This is our first time watching it, completely unfiltered reactions, so buckle up.In this avengers doomsday trailer reaction, we break down every frame of the avengers doomsday official trailer footage — from the return of familiar MCU faces to the first real look at RDJ as Doctor Doom stepping into the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the most unexpected way possible. We talk through the Thor vs Doctor Doom tease, what it means for Captain America, whether Chris Evans is actually back, and how the Fantastic Four and X-Men are being folded into this next chapter of the MCU.Marvel Studios and the Russo Brothers clearly came to Comic Con ready to blow the roof off, and this Special Look proves Avengers: Doomsday is shaping up to be the biggest crossover event yet — bigger than Avengers 5 rumors even hinted at. Doom is coming, and after this teaser, we're more locked in than ever.If you love trailer reaction content, marvel reaction videos, and honest first time watching breakdowns, this is exactly what you're here for. snippet.title: Spiffing Brit vs. Microtransactions
snippet.description:
Welcome to MMORPG Tycoon 2, one of the best management sim games on the market. In this game, we will create our own MMO with one simple goal. To make as much money as possible. The challenge however, is to do this using a free-to-play MMO. This means that I must employ every microtrasaction strategy available to make as much money as possible. This means charging real world cash for everything from spawning to in-game purchases and everything in between. We can't be wasting time on engaging dungeons or monsters to achieve our goal of maximising shareholder value! Luckily you are watching The Spiffing Brit playing a video game so expect Bugs, Glitches and exploits that allow for the most incredible overpowered way of playing MMORPG Tycoon 2 that anyone can do!

snippet.title: Maná - En El Muelle De San Blás (Letra)
snippet.description:
En El Muelle De San Blás - Maná (Letra/Lyrics)

Video Oficial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=teprNzF6J1I

Suscríbete para más letras de tus canciones favoritas 🔥
Activa la campanita 🔔 y no te pierdas ningún estreno.

Letra de la canción:
Ella despidió a su amor, él partió en un barco en el muelle de San Blas
Él juró que volvería y empapada en llanto, ella juró que esperaría
Miles de lunas pasaron y siempre ella estaba en el muelle esperando
Muchas tardes se anidaron, se anidaron en su pelo y en su' labios

Uh-uh-uh-uh-uh, uh-uh
Uh-uh-uh-uh-uh, uh-uh

Llevaba el mismo vestido y por si él volviera no se fuera a equivocar
Los cangrejos le mordían, su ropaje, su tristeza y su ilusión
Y el tiempo se escurrió, y sus ojos se le llenaron de amaneceres
Y del mar se enamoró, y su cuerpo se enraizó en el muelle

Sola, sola en el olvido
Sola, sola con su espíritu
Sola, con su amor el mar
Sola, en el muelle de San Blas

Su cabello se blanqueó, pero ningún barco a su amor le devolvía
Y en el pueblo le decían, le decían la loca del muelle de San Blas
Y una tarde de abril, la intentaron trasladar al manicomio
Nadie la pudo arrancar, y del mar nunca jamás la separaron

Sola, sola en el olvido
Sola, sola con su espíritu
Sola, con su amor el mar
Sola, en el muelle de San Blas

Oh, oh-oh

Sola, sola en el olvido
Sola, sola con su espíritu
Sola, sola con el sol y el mar
Sola, oh sola
Sola en el olvido
Sola, sola con su espíritu
Sola, con su amor el mar
Sola, en el muelle de San Blas

Oh, oh-oh, oh-oh-oh
Ye-eh-eh

Se quedó, se quedó sola, sola
Se quedó, se quedó con el sol y con el mar
Se quedó ahí, se quedó hasta el fin
Se quedó ahí, se quedó en el muelle de San Blas
Woh, oh-oh-oh
Sola, sola se quedó
Woh, oh-oh-oh

snippet.title: New Doomsday Trailer Confirms INSANE PLOT LEAKS & I Can Prove It!!
snippet.description:
There's a new Avengers Doomsday trailer and it CONFIRMS THE INSANE LEAKS!! In this video, I'm breaking down the big questions this trailer leaves you with!! THE LEAKS EXPLAIN IT ALL!!! 


Check out our streams here: @TheDenofNerdsLIVE 

#marvel #mcu #marvelcinematicuniverse 



Marvel fans, Kevin Feige and Marvel Studios revealed A LOT at D23 Brazil over the weekend... In this video, we're breaking EVERYTHING down! This includes some stuff Kevin Feige said that very few are talking about!

Marvel fans, we just got a few reports about Doctor Strange 3 and Blade that change EVERYTHING we thought we knew about the end of the Multiverse Saga! We're breaking down the latest news in this video!

Ever since RDJ got on stage at Comic-Con to reveal he was playing Doctor Doom, fans have wondered WHY... WE NOW HAVE THE ANSWER!!! This video explains all the evidence that is pointing to a MASSIVE TWIST about Iron Man being Victor Von Doom in the MCU's past...

Marvel fan, we have some CRAZY new reveals to discuss today!! We have production updates about Avengers Doomsday and Avengers Secret Wars! We have details about Spider-Man 4 that are interesting AND NEW DETAILS about the Battleworld Movies including Doctor Strange 3 and a SECRET MCU movie that comes out BEFORE Doomsday! Kevin Feige is cooking, and we want to update you about it all!!!

We've got new details about Kevin Feige's plan for RDJ Doctor Doom! This has to do with Avengers Doomsday, Victor and Reed Richards, AND Doctor Doom after Secret Wars!

Marvel fans, we have A TON of new MCU updates and leaks to talk about! There are updates around Doctor Strange 3, a Wanda Scarlet Witch spin off, a Silver Surfer project, AND massive leaks about a scene that sets up RDJ Doctor Doom in the MCU!!!

Marvel fans, we NEED to talk about a new Captain America Brave New World plot leak and how it sets up Kevin Feige's plan for RDJ Doctor Doom! This is really crazy!!! SPOILER WARNING!!!!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about how and insider recently revealed Kevin Feige's plan for Elizabeth Olsen as the Scarlet Witch in the MCU! This is way crazier than I thought it would be! SO MUCH WANDA IS COMING! Could this tie to RDJ Doctor Doom??? I THINK YES!!!

Marvel fans, THIS ONE IS CRAZY! We just got several reports and confirmations from insiders about the changing plot of Tom Holland's Spider-Man 4 and how that will connect to Venom The Last Dance AND KNULL!!! I can't believe they are doing this, and I honestly have some mixed feelings about it...

Marvel fans, we have some MASSIVE news about Tom Holland's Spider-Man 4! We have news of a director AND lots of leakers and insiders have chimed in on what is actually happening behind the scenes. PLUS there's some bad updates about Beyond The Spider-Verse, but I also think I know what's going on there! FULL BREAKDOWN HERE!!!

Marvel fans, we have EVEN MORE set photos from the Fantastic Four! We need to breakdown the potential leak of Frankie Raye Nova as the herald of Galactus AND we need to talk about what is going on in this scene. This was in the old plot leaks and it has to do with Franklin Richards!!!

Marvel fans, we recently got some INSANE reveals about Deadpool and Wolverine AND they are an even bigger deal than most people realize! This has to do with a new Avengers symbol that Ryan Reynolds is teasing AND how it might connect to new rumors about RDJ Iron Man! FULL BREAKDOWN HERE!

Marvel fans, we recently got another trailer for Deadpool and Wolverine and this trailer focused on Logan! However, we've come to realize this Wolverine is NOT WHO YOU THINK! In this video, we break down his true identity AND explain why this is perfect for the MCU!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about Doctor Doom being the villain of Avengers Secret Wars! Some think Kevin Feige is changing the plan to go away from Kang, BUT there's some evidence that Doctor Doom was ALWAYS the planned villain of Avengers Secret Wars! THERE'S ACTUALLY SOME PROOF OF THIS!!

WE JUST GOT ANOTHER X-MEN IN THE MCU! The post-credit scene of The Marvels shows us Beast, BUT it actually shows us much more than most fans think! This scene actually shows us what Kevin Feige's plan for the X-Men in the MCU is! Let's get into this and break it down in FULL DETAIL!

The ending of Loki Season Two was INSANE! But... What actually happened? In this video I'm going to explain what happened, AND I'm going to explain HOW it happened! There are clues in the show, and in other MCU projects, that give us clues to what is really happening for the Loki character. THIS WILL BLOW YOUR MIND!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about new leaked information about the ending of Loki Season 2!! This is really crazy and ties into leaks about Deadpool 3 and Secret Wars in the MCU!! Kevin Feige has some really cool stuff planned for Loki!!!

snippet.description:
Welcome to Clawed full gameplay! Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.  ft @Fisk 

Thank you to Flatrock games for the games keys! 

Follow Me Here:

➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

Need a Server?

If you use this link it supports me directly so thank you!

ABOUT CLAWED:
Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must fight to survive in this Action-Adventure Survival Horror game. Navigate diverse biomes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within the park. With danger lurking at every turn, shoot, strategize, and escape before the park becomes your grave.
Play Classic Mode or Survival Mode
Explore a fully realized dinosaur theme park with two distinct gameplay experiences:
Classic Mode: The original Clawed survival horror experience.
Survival Mode: Survive against hunger, thirst, dynamic weather, a full day/night cycle, and random dinosaur encounters as you complete your mission.
Explore Prehistoria, a rundown dinosaur park that has seen better days. Brave deadly dinosaur enclosures, delve into the underground tunnels, and aquatic environments. The entire park is yours to uncover as you make your way through this action-adventure, survival-horror.
Face off against terrifying dinosaurs, from the ruthless Deinosuchus to the swamp dwelling Spinosaurus, Prehistoria is home to many prehistoric creatures.
In traditional survival-horror fashion, your journey through the park will test your mind and wits as you work to solve challenging puzzles and difficult challenges
Fight dinos, explore the park and solve puzzles with your teammates! Invite your friends to join you on your Journey through Prehistoria.

Game Link:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394840/Clawed/
